channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: St. Lucie County Fire District terminates 3 firefighters, releases hazing investigation reports
item.description: St. Lucie County Fire District on Saturday released investigative reports detailing allegations of hazing and workplace misconduct that led to the termination of 3 firefighters and the suspension of 2 others. item.title: Waterspouts, lightning strikes and fires hit Port St. Lucie and Sebastian during severe weather
item.description: Severe weather on Friday brought waterspouts, lightning strikes and fires across the Treasure Coast, with Port St. Lucie fire crews responding to a brush fire and house fire and a man airlifted to the hospital in Okeechobee County after a lightning strike.

item.title: St. Lucie County Sheriff ramps up traffic enforcement after 1,162 stops in four weeks
item.description: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office is intensifying traffic enforcement this summer, deploying additional deputies to target speeding and reckless driving on Midway Road, U.S. Highway 1 and Indian River Drive.

item.title: Florida fentanyl summit in Orlando draws teens, grieving parents and DEA chief
item.description: Teens from anti-drug coalitions across the country joined grieving parents and DEA Administrator Terrance Cole at the Fentanyl Free America Summit in Orlando this week to discuss stopping fentanyl deaths.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK route in September, cites low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks mile world record that stood for 27 years
item.description: Josh Kerr ran the mile in 3:42.66 Saturday in London, breaking Hicham El Guerrouj's previous mark of 3:43.13 set in 1999. Kerr's sponsor dubbed the effort Project 222, referencing the number of seconds in 3 minutes, 42 seconds.

item.title: Argentina defeats England 2-1 with late goals to reach World Cup final
item.description: Argentina rallied from a 1-0 deficit with two late goals to defeat England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinals. The defending champions will face Spain in the final Sunday in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

item.title: MLB restricts dugout iPad use to prevent artificial intelligence from making game decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday to prevent use of artificial intelligence to help make in-game decisions. The tablets had been used for recommendations on substitutions and pitch calling.

item.title: Photographer's 2007 images of Messi bathing Yamal as baby resurface before World Cup final
item.description: Photographer Joan Monfort took photos in 2007 of teenage Lionel Messi bathing infant Lamine Yamal in a plastic bathtub for a charity calendar. The 19-year-old Yamal will face 39-year-old Messi in Sunday's World Cup final.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final with Secret Service perimeter for Trump attendance
item.description: The World Cup final Sunday in New Jersey will include enhanced Secret Service security with President Trump attending the trophy presentation. A joint operations center has overseen security throughout the tournament.

item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts earn top 15 national finish, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month and qualified for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. item.description:

item.title: Florida Rep. Fabian Basabe Ordered to Pay $450,000 in Sexual Harassment Case
item.description: A Leon County jury found Republican state Rep. Fabian Basabe liable for sexual harassment, battery and defamation, ordering him to pay $450,000.

item.title: Florida Lawmaker Angie Nixon Gets September Trial Date on Capitol Sit-In Charges
item.description: Democratic state Rep. Angie Nixon will stand trial the week of September 21 on misdemeanor charges stemming from her May sit-in outside Gov. Ron DeSantis' Capitol office.

item.title: Trump's National Address Puts Spotlight on Florida Voter Registration Data
item.description: President Donald Trump's Thursday address renewed debate over election security as newly released intelligence records referenced publicly available Florida voter registration data.

item.title: DEA Administrator Joins Florida Fentanyl Summit as Crisis Takes Center Stage
item.description: The Fentanyl Free America Summit in Orlando drew teens from anti-drug coalitions across the country, grieving parents and DEA Administrator Terrance Cole.

item.title: Security First Insurance Lowers Homeowners Rates by Average 5.6% in Florida
item.description: Security First Insurance is lowering homeowners insurance rates by an average of 5.6%, the latest in a series of rate decreases the Florida-based company has made over the last two years.

item.title: Florida Republican Gubernatorial Candidate Faces Antisemitism Ad and Residency Challenge
item.description: Florida gubernatorial candidate James Fishback faces a $400,000 attack ad and a court hearing over whether he meets the state's seven-year residency requirement for governors.

item.title: Byron Donalds, David Jolly Lead Florida Governor's Race as Primary Nears
item.description: Republican U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds and Democrat David Jolly hold commanding positions in Florida's governor's race with the August 18 primary approaching. A Tyson Group survey released this week placed Donalds at 48% among Republicans, followed by Lt. Gov. Jay Collins at 9%, businessman James Fishba

item.title: Palm Beach County man leads Martin County deputies on 100 mph chase through Indiantown
item.description: Markell Tillman, 33, drove more than 100 mph on State Road 710 before leading deputies on a high-speed chase through Indiantown and onto SW Martin Highway toward Palm City.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap over next 20 years
item.description: Martin County will need approximately $2.8 billion for transportation improvements over the next 20 years but only $701 million is currently available, leaving nine needed road widening projects unfunded.

item.title: Jonathan Dickinson State Park concession closed indefinitely, boat rentals and tours suspended
item.description: The concession operation at Jonathan Dickinson State Park is closed indefinitely after the vendor's contract expired, leaving visitors without access to boat rentals, canoe rentals, and the Loxahatchee Queen tour to Trapper Nelson's Island.

item.title: Safe Kids Treasure Coast offering free pool alarms to Martin County residents
item.description: The Florida Department of Health and Safe Kids Treasure Coast are providing a limited supply of free pool alarms to qualifying Martin County residents with residential pools.

item.title: Two Martin County brush fires contained, more expected this summer
item.description: Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike, both now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: Hobe Sound couple seeks support as husband battles head and neck cancer
item.description: Dave and Faren Motz of Hobe Sound are asking for community support as Dave battles head and neck cancer, facing nearly $20,000 in out-of-pocket costs for treatment.

item.title: Murray Middle School demolition underway after Hurricane Milton tornado damage
item.description: Demolition is underway at Murray Middle School in Martin County, marking the start of a major reconstruction effort following tornado damage caused by Hurricane Milton. The project includes reconstruction of buildings destroyed in the tornadoes, along with a new administration building, media center

item.title: Sheriff Richard Del Toro ramps up traffic enforcement across St. Lucie County this summer
item.description: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office is intensifying traffic enforcement this summer, deploying additional deputies to reduce speeding and reckless driving across the county.

item.title: Dale Mincey charged with first-degree murder in fatal shooting of Fort Pierce art teacher Andre Barnes
item.description: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office announced a second arrest in the fatal shooting of Fort Pierce art teacher Andre Leonard Barnes, 66.

item.title: Fort Pierce neighbors pack planning meeting over Causeway Cove high-rise development proposal
item.description: The Causeway Cove development project was reviewed by the Fort Pierce Planning Board on Monday. The project includes five high-rise buildings, including a 17-story building standing 192 feet tall.

item.title: Port St. Lucie couple fights rezoning of lot behind home near Crosstown Parkway
item.description: A Port St. Lucie couple is searching for answers after the city council voted to rezone the lot behind their home from residential to commercial.

item.title: Villa Del Sol residents return home after nearly 2 years following structural damage repairs
item.description: Villa Del Sol residents in St. Lucie County told WPTV they are able to return home after nearly two years of being displaced from their condos.

item.title: St. Lucie County woman wins $5 million from scratch-off ticket purchased in Fort Pierce
item.description: Maria Duran, 57, claimed a $5 million top prize from the $5,000,000 CROSSWORD CASH scratch-off game on April 6.

item.title: Indian River County families can apply for free or reduced-price student meals starting July 15
item.description: Families in Indian River County are able to apply for free or reduced price meals for students starting July 15.
